title: core: invalidate the analysis cache when the learn pipeline's output changes (producer revision)
description:
[found by DSN-4's end-to-end run · exec plan: docs/v2-execution-plan.md · batch B3/B4]
Seats: CORE-07 (learn.rs / stamps owner) + VER-3 (verify)
PROVED DEFECT: the GUI/CLI serve a cached .repowalk/analysis.json whenever the per-file stamps (mtime + line count) match, but the cache key says nothing about WHAT the pipeline produces. CORE-9 changed learn() to fill Analysis.modules/module_edges; every cache written before it is still a HIT and silently reports modules=0. Proof: `repowalk report --json -- .` on this repo printed modules=0 while the code populates them (DSN-4 saw exactly that; the local cache was then removed as a stopgap).
This is R-14's sibling: R-14 is staleness from INPUT changes, this is staleness from PRODUCER changes. Both must be impossible to hit silently.
Deliverable: a producer revision in the cache key. Add `pub const LEARN_REVISION: u32 = 2;` in crates/core/src/learn.rs (doc comment: bump whenever learn()'s output shape or content changes), record it at the top level of the existing `.repowalk/analysis-stamps.json` sidecar (CORE-7 owns this file), and treat a missing or different revision as a full cache miss (re-analyze every file) while keeping the per-file incremental behaviour when the revision matches. Do NOT change ANALYSIS_VERSION or the Analysis schema — analysis.json is frozen at v1; this is a cache key, not a schema change.
Tests: a stamps sidecar carrying revision 1 (or none) forces re-analysis of all files on the next learn; the current revision keeps incremental behaviour (touch one file -> exactly one re-analyzed); the revision is persisted and round-trips; a corrupt sidecar is a full re-analyze, never a panic (and never a silent hit).
Verify hook: hand-write a sidecar with revision 1, run learn, assert reanalyzed == file count; run learn again, assert reanalyzed == 0 AND that Analysis.modules is non-empty on fixtures/sample (the thing CORE-9 added).
Owner files: crates/core/src/learn.rs (+ tests). Do NOT touch analysis.rs, store.rs, pipeline.rs, modules.rs, or GUI/CLI.

EVIDENCE (CORE-01/02, lead TL-CORE, 2026-10-16T00:04:52Z):
- File: crates/core/src/learn.rs ONLY. Added `pub const LEARN_REVISION: u32 = 2;` (doc: bump whenever learn()'s output shape/content changes; it is a cache key, NOT a schema version - ANALYSIS_VERSION stays 1, analysis.json frozen). StampFile now carries a top-level `revision` field, `#[serde(default)]` so a pre-revision sidecar deserializes as 0. `load_stamps` accepts a sidecar only when version==STAMP_VERSION AND revision==LEARN_REVISION; anything else (missing/different/unparsable) is a full cache miss: old_stamps is empty, so every analyzable file lands in `needs`+`stale`, nothing is seeded from the old artifact, and `save_stamps` rewrites the sidecar at LEARN_REVISION. A matched revision leaves the incremental path byte-identical to CORE-7/CORE-9.
- Tests (6 new, in learn.rs): stale_revision_forces_full_reanalysis (revision-1 sidecar => reanalyzed == analyzable_count == 2); missing_revision_forces_full_reanalysis (field absent => 2); current_revision_preserves_incremental_behaviour (warm 0, touch one => 1); revision_roundtrips_through_sidecar (raw JSON revision == LEARN_REVISION == 2 and load_stamps returns Some); corrupt_sidecar_forces_full_reanalysis_without_panic ("{ not valid json" => reanalyzed == 2, no panic, sidecar healed to revision 2); sample_fixture_repopulates_modules_after_revision_bump (real fixtures/sample, copied to a temp dir so it does not race the in-place sample test).
- Verify hook, real numbers (temporary instrumentation, then removed): fixture (2 analyzable) - revision-1 => reanalyzed=2, modules=4; warm => reanalyzed=0. fixtures/sample (6 analyzable) - revision-1 => reanalyzed=6, modules=7, edges=8; warm => reanalyzed=0, modules=7. So a revision-1 cache can no longer serve an empty module tree.
- GATES: `cargo fmt -p repowalk-core -- --check` exit 0; `cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0 (0 warnings); `cargo test -p repowalk-core` exit 0 (lib 155 passed / 0 failed / 2 ignored, incl. the 15 learn tests; integrations 34 passed / 0 failed; 1 doctest). Gates scoped to -p repowalk-core because GRAPH-4/5, TEXT-4, DSN-2/3 are editing crates/gui/** in parallel; I never touched their files.
- R-14 input-staleness path unchanged and still green: the per-file (mtime, line-count) comparison is untouched, and touching one file still re-analyzes exactly that file (1) while a warm re-learn re-analyzes 0 when the revision matches.
- No new dependencies. Nothing committed or pushed.
